description: Modernization tasks for the Ledgerline Sales CRM.

tasks.description: Run the CRM as a client-side Spark-compatible Vite app without Lovable server runtime dependencies.
tasks.reason: The source project used Lovable-managed TanStack Start and SSR configuration; the app now targets the Spark SPA template.
tasks.requirements: Use Vite, React, TanStack Router, Tailwind, and the GitHub Spark runtime. Preserve routes and local-first behavior.

tasks.description: Configure native Windows development and validation with PowerShell, npm, and VS Code workspace tasks.
tasks.reason: The app must run from a Windows developer workspace without bash or Bun.
tasks.requirements: Use PowerShell and npm. Configure VS Code settings, tasks, launch, extensions, and Context7 MCP without storing credentials.

tasks.description: Add scoped Copilot agent guidance for safe evidence-pipeline development.
tasks.reason: The project needs agent assistance while preserving user approval and local-first data boundaries.
tasks.requirements: Define project instructions and an evidence-specific agent. Treat imported text as untrusted data; keep suggested actions pending until user review.

tasks.description: Check dependencies for known security vulnerabilities and retain safe evidence-processing boundaries.
tasks.reason: Modernization includes a security review of dependencies and agent-facing input handling.
tasks.requirements: Run npm audit. Preserve local-only data access and ensure untrusted imported text cannot trigger actions.
